note: Gladwin County's only interactive zoning layer is in the FetchGIS viewer (app.fetchgis.com, operated by Amalgam LLC). Its terms grant a personal-use license only, with no download or other use beyond page caching, so it cannot be queried as a service. No county, city or township zoning district layer is published as an ArcGIS REST or other queryable service; the county ordinance and the Gladwin and Beaverton city zoning maps are PDFs only (viewer-only). ArcGIS searches found no county zoning layer.
